title: SOS: 4.29 Retry-After CBOR payload
description: Gap 3 of a6qg: SOS 4.29 responses carry no Retry-After payload; confessions 4.29 embeds {retry_after} CBOR (precedent: ConfessionsResource lines 310-315, congestion_service_unavailable in coap/params.py).
